caption.text:
Kapal KM Mutiara Sentosa 2 rute Surabaya-Makassar terbakar di perairan utara Sumenep, Madura, Minggu (2/8).⁠
⁠
Kebakaran menyebabkan asap hitam pekat membubung dari badan kapal. Sejumlah penumpang bahkan nekat melompat ke laut untuk menyelamatkan diri.⁠
⁠
Kepala Kantor SAR Surabaya Nanang Sigit mengatakan, berdasarkan perkembangan situasi terakhir, para penumpang yang melompat ke laut berhasil dievakuasi oleh kapal yang berada di sekitar lokasi.⁠
⁠
“Beberapa penumpang melompat ke laut dan dievakuasi oleh TB Hasnur 26 dan Kapal British Mentor. Di sekitar lokasi ada empat kapal yang merapat,” kata Nanang kepada kumparan, Minggu (2/8).⁠
⁠
Nanang menjelaskan, informasi awal mengenai insiden tersebut diterima Kantor SAR Surabaya pada pukul 08.24 WIB dari Syahbandar Tanjung Perak. Selang satu menit kemudian, PT Atosim Lampung Pelayaran (ALP) juga menghubungi petugas siaga untuk melaporkan bahwa KM Mutiara Sentosa 2 yang berlayar dari Surabaya menuju Makassar terbakar.⁠
⁠
Berdasarkan laporan sementara, kapal mengangkut sekitar 250 orang atau person on board (POB).⁠
⁠
📸: Dok. Istimewa.⁠

caption.text_translation:
Ship KM Mutiara Sentosa 2 route Surabaya-Makassar caught fire in the northern waters of Sumenep, Madura, Sunday (2/8).

The fire caused thick black smoke to cover from the hull of the ship. Some passengers were even willing to jump into the sea to save themselves.

Surabaya SAR Office Chief Nanang Sigit said, based on the latest situation, the passengers who jumped into the sea were successfully evacuated by the ship nearby the location.

“Several passengers jumped into the sea and were evacuated by TB Hasnur 26 and British Mentor Vessel. Around the location are four ships docked,” Nanang said to the coil, Sunday (2/8).

Nanang explains, initial information regarding the incident was received by the Surabaya SAR Office at 08.24 pm from Syahbandar Tanjung Perak. One minute later, PT Atosim Lampung Pelayaran (ALP) also contacted the standby officer to report that KM Mutiara Sentosa 2 which was sailing from Surabaya to Makassar was on fire.

Based on the interim report, the ship carried about 250 people or person on board (POB).

 📸: Dok. Istimewa.
